purpose: Teach: 下地/吉村/日野/松原/三田/岩崎/山岡/稲葉

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、指導教授の下地先生のご研究を継承しろ
lines.en: Ren — inherit your mentor Professor Shimoji's research direction.
lines.style: Direct, measured authority. Clear vocal weight on the instruction itself. Brief pause after the name — this is not a suggestion. Composed, expecting compliance without needing to enforce it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。吉村教授の論文を読み込みます
lines.en: Yes. I'll read through Professor Yoshimura's papers thoroughly.
lines.style: Formal acknowledgment with quiet determination. Slight emphasis on the commitment — he's already mentally organizing the work. Respectful cadence, no hesitation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、共同研究の日野先生に研究照会しろ
lines.en: Ren — consult with Professor Hino about the collaborative research.
lines.style: Another instruction, same measured tone as before. Slight emphasis on 'consult' — this is foundational work, not optional. Eyes steady.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。学会で松原助教のご発表を聴きます
lines.en: Yes. I'll attend Assistant Professor Matsubara's presentation at the conference.
lines.style: Accepting this as part of the same research chain. Quiet thoroughness in the delivery. Slight nod-forward quality, like he's already mentally scheduling it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、東京三田の慶応キャンパスにも足を運べ
lines.en: Ren — visit the Keio campus in Mita, Tokyo as well.
lines.style: Expanding the scope steadily. Calm authority, no rush. The final item feels inevitable rather than demanding. Brief emphasis on 'as well' — part of the larger arc.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。岩崎家ご令孫の留学先と連携します
lines.en: Yes. I'll coordinate with the Iwasaki family's exchange student's institution.
lines.style: Acknowledging a more complex requirement. Slight hesitation — this one has layers — but recovered smoothly. Formal respect maintained. Shows he understands this is a network, not just tasks.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、海外連携の山岡教授と打ち合わせしろ
lines.en: Ren — meet with Professor Yamaoka about international partnerships.
lines.style: The penultimate instruction. Vocal steady and clear. This one carries slightly less pressure than the others — it's about collaboration, not urgent direction. Still authoritative.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究費の窓口、稲葉事務官に申請します
lines.en: Yes. I'll submit the application to Ms. Inaba in the research funding office.
lines.style: Final affirmation. Slightly longer, more detailed than the previous responses — he's showing he understands the administrative thread. Quiet resolve. Closes the series with a sense of having absorbed the full mandate.
